subject: pip-audit reports 207 vulnerabilities in 27 Python packages while Dependabot shows no open pip alert
activeForm: Reconciling pip-audit with Dependabot's pip coverage

origin.evidence: make validate  # dependency audit stage: 'Found 207 known vulnerabilities in 27 packages'; then make check-security-alerts

work_items: Card #NEW: measure why pip-audit and Dependabot disagree on Python vulnerabilities, and fix whichever side is blind

description:
Found by card #15. MEASURED 2026-10-10: make validate's dependency audit stage (pip-audit, ADVISORY and ending in || true) reports 207 known vulnerabilities in 27 packages, aiohttp 3.13.3 first. Dependabot has 47 pip records for this repo and 0 open (make check-security-alerts), and the dependency graph lists 103 PyPI packages.

The cause is unmeasured. One fact narrows it: aiohttp appears in none of requirements.txt, requirements-dev.txt or requirements-ci.txt, so pip-audit is auditing the installed venv (the root checkout's .venv) rather than the declared manifests. Candidates: venv drift from the pins, transitive packages the manifests do not lock and Dependabot cannot see, or packages only the venv carries. Measure which, before deciding whether the manifests need a lock or the venv needs a rebuild.
